title: Bananas emit antimatter, at a homeopathic rate
body: Bananas contain potassium-40, a naturally radioactive isotope whose rare decay branch emits a positron, antimatter, roughly once every hour or so per banana. The dose is beyond negligible, but the physics is real: antimatter is not only laboratory exotica. Physicists use the banana equivalent dose, tongue in cheek, to calibrate public fear of radiation.
